shortDescription: LG Styler® Steam Closet picks up where your usual wash and dry routine leaves off, for easy, hands-free care for a wide range of clothing and household items, including silk, cashmere and leather. More capacity means you can do less ironing, less dry cleaning, less hanging your shirt in the bathroom to de-wrinkle while you shower. The enhanced steam generator saves you time with faster cycles, while the redesigned pants press makes it easy to keep pants looking crisp and freshly pressed.

features.text: Dual TrueSteam®  Technology
This powerful yet gentle feature uses steam to sanitize, refresh and deodorize your clothes without bleach, soaps or harsh chemicals.
Select Heavy Duty Sanitary cycle to help reduce allergens like pet dander and dust mites, Light cycle for lingerie or other delicates, or Normal cycle for everything in between.
The right amount of steam is then directed to clothes through two steam outlets.
QuickRefresh™
Pressed for time? Now you can quickly refresh your clothes and reduce wrinkles and odors in about 22 minutes with the QuickRefresh™ cycle.
It’s perfect for when you’re in a hurry but still want your clothes to look and feel fresh.
Dynamic MovingHanger™
With space to hang up to 5 items, the Dynamic MovingHanger™ is the perfect way to shake up your routine and shake off the work.
It effectively moves clothes through the circulating hot steam using up to 350 twisting motions per minute to help sanitize, refresh and deodorize your clothes.
Features 6 different motions, each optimized for different garment types and cycle settings and designed to keep vibration to a minimum for quiet performance.
Built-In HandySteamer™
LG Styler®  is all about hands-off clothing care, but for those times when you want to be a little more hands-on, the Built-In HandySteamer™ is ready when you are.
It includes 3 different steam settings that are perfect for reducing wrinkles or providing extra detailing right where you need it.
Stows away neat and easy in its own quick-access compartment.
Plug & Go Design
LG Styler®  lives where you do with its slim design, ultra-quiet operation—and no need for an electrician or plumber.
Simply plug into a standard outlet and place it in a foyer, entryway, mudroom, garage, walk-in closet or anywhere it’s convenient for you to use every day.
Dual Inverter HeatPump™
Uses low temperatures and indirect heat to avoid damage while refreshing clothes and drying delicates MUCH faster than air drying neatly out of sight.
We’ve enhanced the design for greater efficiency and faster cycles to save time and energy.
Quickly and gently dry everything from knit sweaters to hats and lingerie, or even warm bath towels and jammies for a cozy finish to your day.
EZ Fit PantsPress™
If you love the look of freshly pressed pants but don’t love the thought of ironing, our EZ Fit PantsPress™ keeps your pants looking sharp with minimal effort.
The multi-plate design makes it easy to take care of those hard-to-maintain creases and smooth wrinkle-prone areas in just minutes
AutoFresh System™ + Space Dehumidification
AutoFresh System™ continually circulates air to help reduce moisture inside the steam closet and keep clothes fresh and ready to wear.
Space dehumidification can also help reduce moisture in your surrounding space by removing moisture from humid air and circulating dry air into the room all without opening the door.
